adapter_hint: SingStat table M810771 (residents by planning region, age, sex): python -m scripts.fetch_census.singstat
population_note: SingStat counts residents -- citizens and permanent residents. Singapore's total population is considerably larger: roughly 1.8 million people on work passes and other long-term permits are enumerated nationally but not in this series, so the five regions do not sum to the country figure shown above.
median_age_note: Interpolated from the five-year age bands SingStat publishes, not a median the Department reported. It is also the median age of residents only. Elsewhere on this map median age is a published figure, so the two are not exactly like for like.
ethnicity_note: Summed from the Census of Population 2020 rows of the 19 planning areas it lists for this region: 922,580 residents. Marina East, Marina South and Straits View have no published residents.
religion_note: Summed from the Census of Population 2020 rows of the 13 planning areas it lists for this region: 760,678 residents aged 15 and over, so shares of adults. The census folds Museum, Newton, Orchard, Rochor, Singapore River and Southern Islands into an 'Others' row that cannot be split by region, so they are not included: 28,010 residents in 2020, 3.0% of the region. Marina East, Marina South and Straits View have no published residents.
language_note: Summed from the Census of Population 2020 rows of the 13 planning areas it lists for this region: 754,170 residents aged 5 and over, the language most often spoken at home. The census folds Museum, Newton, Orchard, Rochor, Singapore River and Southern Islands into an 'Others' row that cannot be split by region, so they are not included: 28,010 residents in 2020, 3.0% of the region. Marina East, Marina South and Straits View have no published residents.
